blocking_findings.finding: The action hash does not specify domain-tag framing, raw-versus-hex digest and master-seed encodings, or exact PRNG protocol_id and cohort_id values. Multiple byte transcripts can satisfy the prose while producing different actions and rows.

The online state machine does not fix whether action_t and q_current are selected before or after the previous-transition theta update, when the current model action executes, whether reward uses pre-update or post-update mu, or the exact pending x_previous, q_previous, and previous action-cost representation.

The fit and tune stream roster is undefined because pure_noise_v4 is required but absent from the family map. Event-camera index and polarity draw order, duplicate-index handling, sampled-index-zero handling, global conditional draw order, and exact source-ID serialization are not frozen.

The declared 112-byte fit state omits pending transition state required across batch-one observe calls even though the lock acknowledges pending state. Fit-update operation accounting also lacks a numeric algebra for clips, comparisons, increments, and writes, so the byte and total-operation gates are not reproducible.

matched_random is declared assessment-only while the tune gate requires a matched-random comparison. No post-candidate tune pass is defined, and the noise-floor, oracle-feature, row-251, and pure-noise control execution semantics are incomplete.

The eight mechanism tests lack an exact paired transform, raw-test formula, and family-by-ablation tie order. The always-skip Holm family and reward-shift failure predicates are undefined, so multiplicity and mechanism qualification can fail open.

Adaptation-lag baselines are not explicitly arm-specific and a recovery scan for the first piecewise-drift shift can cross the second shift. Segment end bounds and interrupted-segment censoring are not defined.

The lock and validator name high-level digests but do not freeze schemas for pending state, control receipts, ablation statistics, operation rows, or assessment-absence evidence. Independent validation cannot uniquely resolve the other ambiguities after implementation.

digest_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(payload_without_review_digest, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True)

nonblocking_findings.finding: The complete-policy paired estimand includes all parameter carryover and avoids the unsupported isolated-action causal claim that blocked V3.
The displayed true-online Sarsa-lambda recurrence has the established Dutch-trace algebra once action-selection and transition ordering are made exact.
The recomputed normal-approximation power at alpha 0.0125, n 48, and standardized effect 0.5 is exactly 0.8330770040094296, and its scope is correctly limited to the primary family statistics.
Fit, tune, and assessment seed cohorts are disjoint; zero model resets, pre-update loss, terminal no-update handling, source order, and high-level carryover boundaries are coherent.
The guard and V1-V3 remain closed, V2 energy is ineligible, real execution is separately sealed, and Astral remains isolated.
All six reusable source digests embedded in the machine protocol matched their current files at review time.

required_successor_corrections: Freeze one length-framed byte transcript for domain tags, protocol digest, master seed, stream and cohort identifiers, integers, thresholds, and all SplitMix64 initialization values.
Freeze an indexed controller state machine covering action selection, q evaluation, reward, theta, trace, q-old, dual update, model action, terminal handling, and every pending field.
Freeze the exact fit and tune stream roster plus every per-stream draw order, collision rule, forced-feature rule, source-ID encoding, and control algorithm.

Name every persistent and ephemeral field with width and lifetime, and provide closed numeric formulas for operations, writes, events, updates, hashes, clips, comparisons, counters, and family aggregation.
Resolve the matched-random tune contradiction and freeze all ablation execution order, paired transforms, raw tests, Holm families and tie order, and reward-shift rejection predicates.
Make adaptation baselines arm-specific or shared by an explicit rule, stop each recovery scan at the next shift, and freeze interrupted-segment censoring.
Freeze canonical lock, control, ablation, counter, assessment-absence, and validator schemas before another independent review.
